scripts.build: npm run content:build && npm run build:app -- --local-media
scripts.test: node --import remix/node-tsx --test content/tests/*.test.ts website/app/document-host/*.test.ts website/app/newsletter/*.test.ts && playwright test --config content/playwright.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.typecheck:website: wrangler types --config website/wrangler.jsonc worker-configuration.d.ts && tsc --noEmit -p website/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:website: node --import remix/node-tsx --test website/app/newsletter/*.test.ts website/app/document-host/*.test.ts && playwright test --config website/playwright.config.ts
scripts.check:website: prettier website contracts dev.ts tsconfig.json package.json .github/workflows --check && npm run typecheck:website && npm run test:website
